text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—I can't wait for the Satsuki Sho! I won't 
let this chance I've seized slip away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh god, the broadcast is intense... I 
feel sick... If I embarrass myself... if I 
let everyone down... —I wanna go home..."

The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first race 
of the Classic Triple Crown, has arrived.

The girls running are wrapped up in joy, 
anxiety, tension... all sorts of emotions 
about being in this race, and the air is 
thick with anticipation—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...So damn loud.

Even Air Shakur, on this particular day, 
couldn't completely shut out the reactions 
from the crowd around her.
choice_data_list: It's the Satsuki Sho, after all.
It is the Satsuki Sho, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What we actually do doesn't change, does 
it? You run, and someone wins. That's all 
there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go wastin' your energy before we 
even run, dammit."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?

I was about to point out that she was 
being "more talkative than usual," but 
held my tongue, thinking it might pour 
cold water on her mood.
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch.

After changing, Air Shakur had regained 
more of his composure than this morning, 
but... there was still a hint of 
irritation visible.
choice_data_list:
...It did reach the theoretical value, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It was barely enough, though. What's the 
point of checking that now?
choice_data_list:
Then that makes Shakur the strongest 
today.

Then that makes Shakur the strongest 
today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm going.

All that's left is to run without regret, 
just like in all the simulations we've 
run.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Air Shakur! How are you feeling 
to—
(Glare!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Th-They're on fire again today...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... the noise is on a whole 'nother 
level of annoying. Was the Satsuki Sho 
always this bad?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No, I know. Dammit, my heart rate is 
higher than expected...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Take a deep breath. That's it. The 
numbers prove it, don't they?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The strongest one out there today is 
without a doubt— me.
